prediction.headline: chance of a high-accident year
prediction.target: Chance of a high-accident year ahead: lost-time and fatal accidents at 3 or more per 100 workers
prediction.none: No prediction yet. The daily score job computes it.
prediction.fleet: Higher than {{pct}} % of the monitored mines
prediction.factorsHint: Percentage points each adds to the {{total}} chance
prediction.factorViolationDetail: {{value}} per 100 workers a year, higher than {{pct}} % of the monitored mines
prediction.noFactors: Nothing raises it above a typical mine.
prediction.transferNote: Trained on US regulator data and transferred: a prompt to look closer, not a forecast.
prediction.about: Gradient-boosted trees, fitted on US coal mine-years from the regulator (MSHA) for 2017-2020, calibrated on 2021 and tested on 2022-2024, years it had never seen. On those years it ranked mines better than last year's accident rate alone: AUC {{auc}} against {{baseline}}. It reaches these mines by matching violation categories; it was not trained on Indian mines.
